content: Pharmacologic therapy for adults with type 2 diabetes, as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), should be tailored and adjusted based on the effectiveness of the treatment in achieving glycemic and metabolic targets. Treatment options include intensifying pharmacologic interventions, such as the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists or SGLT2 inhibitors, among other medications. Lifestyle modifications should also be implemented as part of the therapeutic approach. If individual treatment goals remain unmet despite these measures, combination pharmacologic therapies or metabolic surgery should be considered as potential strategies to optimize outcomes.
